videos.script: Lesson 7 sent Lantern's customers to a CRM with a script you could read in one sitting. {{script}} Companies pay for products that do the same job. Hightouch, Census, and Segment are the three you will meet. {{three}} None of them runs on your machine, so this lesson does not pretend to click through them. {{honest}} Instead it takes each decision you made by hand, and finds the setting it became. {{settings}} The match key. The sync mode. What happens to a customer who left the model. {{decisions}} Segment also collects events from the website and the app. That brings a new failure. {{events}} A release renames one event, and a funnel quietly stops counting a step. {{rename}} A tracking plan is the defence, and you will check one in SQL against a day of Lantern's events. {{plan}} Then the question every company meets: should the customer profile live in the warehouse, or with a vendor? {{where}} And before signing anything, the questions to ask. {{questions}}
